lines: d27: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Tanya Jankowski is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d27: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d27: 🕯️ Tanya is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d27: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.
d27: 🕯️ Tanya Jankowski is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d27: What Tanya kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d27: "Tanya's gone." Erich looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Tanya." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d27: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Hannah blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d27: 📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
d27: 📖 LEARNED: Boiling Water (Level 1). Rolling boil for 1 minute kills most pathogens. The simplest safe water.
d27: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d27: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d27: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d27: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Tanya Jankowski, 27 days. The mantle passes to Hannah Kim.
d27: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Hannah Kim, 28 — a Chef. Her hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Beard Moss, Green Thumb, Literally.
d27: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d27: The village's quarrel was with Tanya — and Tanya is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d27: At the grave, Erich, Monique, Mario and 4 more speak for Hannah — "Tanya trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d27: The fire knew Hannah before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
